name: The Migdal Room
description: Mandaean Canon and counter-gospel architecture. Lunar Arm theological node. The Migdal connection. Depends on Revelation Room and Sacred Heart system.

constitution.ontology: Every occurrence of this locus in the archive is inside a list of room names. Deposit #297 records the relation explicitly: "The Migdal Room / minted_in / CRIMSON HEXAGON: CENTRAL NAVIGATION MAP v2.0". The room exists because a navigation map enumerated it. No deposit takes it as subject; a title sweep returns zero across 1,519 deposits. This is not a gap in the archive’s holdings but a fact about the locus’s origin, and it is declared rather than filled, because an undeclared absence is what a retrieval system fills in.

gap_declaration.rule: Declared absence is inert; undeclared absence gets filled in. This locus carries no constituting document and the archive says so rather than allowing a retrieval system to supply one.
